# discourse time of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:discourseTimeOf`](gmeow-discourseTimeOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/discourseTimeOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

Anchors a discourse-time frame to the creative work (expression or manifestation tier) whose telling order it coordinatizes. Functional: one frame, one telling. Different editions or translations that re-segment the text own different discourse frames; positions do not transfer between them without an explicit mapping claim.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NarrativeTimeFrame`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeTimeFrame.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md); functional
